messages:
Eva: Quick sync — working with Acme Solutions (SI) and Ampere partner on a marketplace refkit. Need final checklist for: Terraform modules, ARM64/OAMP optimizations, packaging sample, and marketplace listing metadata. Can we QA the module and cert timeline?

Noah: I can take the Terraform module QA. What's the target module name / repo?

Ali: Repo is github.com/redwood/refkits/acme-cloud-solution (private). Module name: redwood_acme_refkit. I'll paste minimal example.

Ali: ```hcl
module "acme_refkit" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/refkits/acme-cloud-solution//terraform?ref=v1.0.0"
  region = "us-east-1"
  instance_type = "m6a.large" # arm64 perf
}
```

Jess: Note: for Ampere we need a quantization profile and a kernel hint in README, plus an `arm64.md` with perf numbers. Also add `provider_constraints` in versions.tf.

Noah: I'll run `terraform init` + smoke tests on AWS and GCP tomorrow. Any acceptance tests we should include?

Eva: Add these to checklist: 1) terraform module lint + docs, 2) automated smoke tests (invoke model server on ARM64 image), 3) marketplace metadata YAML filled (support_region, eula, hsm_compat), 4) compliance matrix, 5) SI runbook for install + upgrade.

Samir: For marketplace listing, marketing needs a short blurb (1-2 lines), logo asset, and a 2-minute demo video. I'll coordinate.

Deploy-bot: build pipeline passed on branch acme/refkit/v1.0.0 :white_check_mark:

Ali: Small gotcha — GCP images need a startup script tweak for NVMe device naming on Ampere instances, add to README.

Jess: Proposed owners: Noah (module QA), Ali (docs + readme), Samir (marketplace assets), Eva (SI coordination). Can we mark dates?

Eva: Timeline proposal: module QA by 2024-06-05, docs by 2024-06-07, marketplace submit by 2024-06-10. @Noah @Ali @Samir please confirm.

Noah: Confirmed. Setting calendar event.

Ali: Confirmed, will push arm64.md PR today.

Samir: Confirmed. I'll record the demo this week.

Eva: Great — I'll update the partner tracker and ping Acme for review. Thanks :rocket:
